name: Budapest
dek: Belterület, WMO 12840, the inner-city station. Pestszentlőrinc is not mixed in.
paragraphs: Budapest-Belterület is WMO 12840. The file gives the height as 153 m and the position in its own pipe notation. Pestszentlőrinc is WMO 12843, also in Budapest, with its own complete temperature and precipitation rows. It is not this table.
The country sheet uses Belterület and says so. Use this page for Budapest. The plug, the road rule, and the tipping note are the national ones.

climate.caption: Reference station: Budapest-Belterület, WMO 12840. The inner-city station in the file, not Pestszentlőrinc, and not a national average.
climate.note: World Meteorological Organization 1991–2020 climatological standard normals, distributed by NOAA NCEI. Monthly values are copied as printed. Budapest-Pestszentlőrinc, WMO 12843, is a second Budapest station in the Hungarian submission. It was not averaged with Belterület.

plugs.label: Plugs and voltage
plugs.value: Type C and F, 230 V, 50 Hz
plugs.detail: The IEC world-plugs list, in the copy archived on 16 August 2026, shows Hungary at the voltage, frequency, and plug types in the figure. A direct download of the live page on 15 November 2026 did not return the list. The archive is the copy that was read.

driving.label: Driving side
driving.detail: Section 25(2) of the joint KPM–BM decree 1/1975, in the National Legal Repository text that prints 2026.01.01 under the title, says a vehicle on the carriageway must travel on the right-hand side in the direction of travel, keeping to the right as far as the road and traffic conditions allow, except when overtaking or passing.

tipping.label: Tipping
tipping.detail: Visit Hungary's money page says the usual amount of a tip is 10 percent, for cabs and restaurants among other places, and that if a card is used the staff prefers the tip in cash. The same page says a 10 to 15 percent service charge added to the bill is just starting to spread, and that if it is included you do not need to tip. No date is printed on the page.

water.label: Tap water
water.detail: CDC's traveler page for Hungary, last reviewed 25 August 2026, does not say whether tap water is safe or unsafe. It says food and water standards around the world vary based on the destination, that standards may also differ within a country, and that risk may change depending on the activity. It points readers to CDC's food and water precautions. This page does not turn that into medical advice.

currency.label: Currency
currency.detail: ISO 4217 lists the currency name Forint and the code HUF for Hungary. The list's published date, in the Pblshd attribute, is 17 September 2026.

timeZone.label: Time zone
timeZone.detail: IANA's zone.tab and zone1970.tab each give Hungary one row, Europe/Budapest. There is no second Hungary zone in either file.

entry.label: Official entry requirements
entry.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade, consular information
entry.note: The ministry's consular page on visa-free travel to Hungary. We do not restate a visa rule.
